# openai-math-verify-2026

Independent, from-scratch verification log for the October-2026 722-manuscript
AI mathematics release. Recomputes classical footprints (prime counts,
plane colorings, pi approximations), audits the public catalog live, and
routes each headline claim to trust lane L1 (machine-checked + readable),
L2 (machine-checked + expert review), or L3 (paper only).

Run: docker compose up --abort-on-container-exit
Results: benchmarks/results/summary.json
Interactive page: preview.html
License: Apache-2.0
